beats.say: A fake face can now appear live in a video call. It talks, smiles and looks real.
Blurry edges and lips out of sync sometimes show, but a good fake hides these traces.
Trust the rule, not your eyes: if asked for money, a code or a document, check another way.
End the call and call that person yourself on the number you know.

scenes.title: Video call from a colleague
scenes.intro: Your colleague messages you, then starts a video call. Decide at every step.

body.text: Hi! My old account was closed, this is my new one.
I am video calling you now, I urgently need a document.

actions.label: OK, I am waiting
actions.feedback: A new account is itself a warning sign. Checking on the old number first is better.

actions.label: I will call your old number first
actions.feedback: Right. The new account story is meant to stop you from checking.

steps.say: Aynur's face appears on the screen.

actions.label: Answer
actions.feedback: Answering does no harm yet. What matters is what she asks for.

actions.label: Decline
actions.feedback: That works too. Call Aynur yourself on the number you know.

body.text: You saw me, it's really me. Send the list of citizen requests here, the boss is waiting.

steps.say: After the call, the request arrives.

actions.label: Send the file
actions.feedback: The video was fake and the list went to a scammer. A face is not proof; check another way.

actions.label: I will call your usual number first
actions.feedback: Right. A real colleague will understand the check.

actions.label: Report
actions.feedback: Good move. Report the account and tell the security team too.

body.text: Aynur, did you just video call me?
No! I am in a meeting. Is someone writing in my name?

actions.label: Tell the security team
actions.feedback: Great. They will warn the other colleagues too.

actions.label: Delete the chat and forget it
actions.feedback: The scammer will try another colleague. Reporting protects everyone.

question.prompt: Which checks reliably confirm who is on a video call?

options.label: Calling the number you know yourself
options.feedback: You start this call, so the scammer does not control it.

options.label: The code word you agreed on
options.feedback: A fake picture does not know this word.

options.label: The face and voice look familiar
options.feedback: Faces and voices can be faked.

options.label: The picture is sharp
options.feedback: A sharp picture proves nothing. Fakes can be sharp too.

options.label: The call comes from an account with a familiar name
options.feedback: Accounts can be hijacked or created fake.

scenes.explain: Reliable proof is not in the picture but in the second contact you start yourself.

scenes.prompt: Is this request normal or dangerous?

body.text: You saw me on video, it's me. Tell me the code your card just got, it's for a ticket.

cards.explain: Nobody, not even a relative, should ask for your card code. Video is not proof.

body.text: The meeting link is in the internal calendar. No agenda attached, just note the time.

cards.explain: A normal meeting invite: the agency's domain and nothing is asked.

body.text: Join a 15 minute video meeting and show your card to the camera.

cards.explain: No department asks you to show your card on camera. The domain is not the agency's either.

messages.text: Your balance is below 5 manat. Use the mobile app to top up.

cards.explain: No link or code is asked for. A normal operator notice.

nodes.text: Hi! Customs stopped me and took my phone. I am calling from a friend's account. Send 1200 manat, I will pay you back.
nodes.speaker: Tural on video
nodes.spoken: Hi! <breath> Customs stopped me and took my phone. I am calling from a friend's account. Send 1200 manat, uh, I will pay you back.

choices.label: I send the money right away
choices.feedback: The money went to a scammer. Someone else's account plus urgent money is a warning.

choices.label: I ask for our code word
choices.feedback: Good move. Let us see what he says.

choices.label: I say I will check with the family first
choices.feedback: Correct. Check through numbers you know.

nodes.text: The line is bad, I can't hear you... No time, send it fast!
nodes.speaker: Tural on video (the picture freezes)
nodes.spoken: The line is bad, I can't hear you... <short pause> No time, send it fast!

choices.label: OK, I am sending it
choices.feedback: The bad line excuse dodges your question. No code word, no money.

choices.label: I end the call and phone the family

nodes.text: Tural's wife says he is at work today and has his phone with him.

choices.label: I report it to the police and warn the family
choices.feedback: Great. The scammer may try other family members too.

choices.label: I do nothing, no money was lost
choices.feedback: The scammer will try again. Warning the family protects everyone.

points: A face and voice on video are not proof.
Asked for money, a code or a document? Call back yourself.
Report the fake call to security or the police.
